title: Cardiopulmonary Arrest Code Blue Response
content:
SOP: Cardiopulmonary Arrest Code Blue Response (SOP-CAR-001)
DEPARTMENT: Cardiology
VERSION: 3.5
ROLES: doctor, nurse, icu_team
PURPOSE: Mobilize crash cart and emergency airway team under 3 minutes.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Cardiopulmonary Arrest Code Blue Response in full compliance with Cardiology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Cardiopulmonary Arrest Code Blue Response in full compliance with Cardiology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Cardiopulmonary Arrest Code Blue Response in full compliance with Cardiology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Cardiopulmonary Arrest Code Blue Response in full compliance with Cardiology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Cardiopulmonary Arrest Code Blue Response in full compliance with Cardiology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Cardiopulmonary Arrest Code Blue Response in full compliance with Cardiology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Cardiology.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
